'''The Real World in The Wheel of Time''' is the fourth and final chapter of {{origins}}.

The chapter covers many of the real-world events, people, locations, and things that inspired or were referenced by the text of ''[[The Wheel of Time]]''. It includes several photos pertaining to the subject.
